EPISODE NUMBER: Episode 1
EPISODE LOGLINE: Mara Vale is humiliated at her engagement party when her fiancé announces he is marrying her stepsister, until a silent stranger in the corner steps forward.
CONTINUITY NOTES: First episode. Establishes Mara, her fiancé Victor, her stepsister Lena and the unnamed stranger.

--- SCRIPT START ---

Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 01:01.50

Start: (00:03.00) | End: (00:06.00)
Mara descends the staircase in a silver gown, smiling at Victor.

**VICTOR (Cold, Loud):**
Start: (00:06.00) | End: (00:08.50)
"Stop right there, Mara."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:08.50) | End: (00:10.50)

**VICTOR (Cruel, Smug):**

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:15.00) | End: (00:17.00)

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:17.00) | End: (00:19.50)

Start: (00:19.50) | End: (00:22.50)

**LENA (Venomous):**

Start: (00:27.50) | End: (00:29.50)

**VICTOR (Dismissive):**
Start: (00:29.50) | End: (00:32.50)

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:32.50) | End: (00:35.00)

**MARA (Gasping):**

**SOUND FX:**
